content: Google's web is falling apart in front of us. It's objecting to sites that support HTTPS as if they were those oldfashioned HTTP pages. I'm sorry I wrote them so long ago, but some of them are funny, like the one I wrote on my birthday in 2005, a story about the TV show The West Wing. By 2005 we were ready to live in that world instead of the one we lived in. We've been back there dreaming of the West Wing ever since. Anyway if Google is going to desert the web I hope they don't mind if we rebuild it? And if I have to fix my archives up, let's do it up really well. Anyway here's a link to the original story, good luck reading it through Google, and here's story in Markdown, where you can read it in BonBonWeb.
